item.text: I found the failure path: `ListRecord.from_input()` calls `web.input()`, which combines URL and body fields. Its `seeds=[]` default can also occupy the `seeds` key before indexed fields are unflattened. I’m writing regressions for body precedence, indexed seeds, and repeated flattened assignments before changing the parser.
